ask: How does ZIGoals keep my data?
reply:
Here's what the Help notes on this page say:

- **On your device first.** Every record stays in your browser on this device. Nothing is uploaded unless you turn on encrypted sync for an account.
- **Health is separate.** Even with sync on, Health only syncs if you opt in to that as well.
- **Encrypted sync.** Your records are encrypted on your device before they leave it. The server keeps only the encrypted data and the details it needs to deliver it. It can't read your plans, habits or health entries.
- **Sign-in is not recovery.** Signing in with an email code doesn't unlock your data. Only your recovery secret does, so keep it somewhere safe.
- **Backups are up to you.** You can make an encrypted backup with its own secret, export each area in a readable form, or use Export everything to get a readable ZIP.
- **About me.** I'm your own AI, connected through your key, a local model or OpenRouter's sign-in. ZIGoals runs no AI service and sees none of this conversation. Settings → ZIGi · your AI turns me off and forgets the key.

Also, the Alpha runs on a test network, so none of the money in it is real.

If you'd like, I can explain how sync or backups work in more detail.
